name: FairCher
description: FairCher is an ad intelligence tool that provides transparency into search, display, social, streaming, and broadcast advertising.

tools.name: advertising_activity_scan
tools.description: Determines whether a business, brand, or domain is actively advertising across major paid media channels.

entity.description: The business name, brand name, or domain to evaluate (e.g. "Acme Corp", "acme.com", "Nike").

channel.description: Optional channel constraint. If omitted or set to "any", the tool will evaluate channels in priority order and stop on first positive detection.

region.description: Optional geographic focus (e.g. US, EU, global).

tools.name: advertising.activity_lookup
tools.description: Looks up advertising activity using the Google Ads Transparency Center.

domain.description: Brand name or domain (e.g. nike.com, Coca-Cola)
